"""Launch the sole fixed V167 postprocess queue after real import preflight."""
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V167-bounded-support-v1'
launch=read(root/'launch-v1.json');assert live(launch['owner'])
assert read(root/'postprocess-import-preflight-v1.json')['returncode']==0
assert not (root/'postprocess-controller.claim').exists() and not (root/'queue-launch-v1.json').exists()
with (root/'queue-controller-v1.log').open('x') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(repo/'.cache/queue-v167-review-v1.py')],cwd=repo,
    env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH='src:scripts',OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1'),
    stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
 owner={'pid':p.pid,'created':psutil.Process(p.pid).create_time()}
save(root/'queue-launch-v1.json',{'status':'original-review-queue-launched','owner':owner,'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),
    'expected_training_owner':launch['owner'],'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
print(owner)
